auto_wait.label: waits for an automatic trigger
auto_wait.description: Waits for an automatic trigger; the controller acts without a human. A guard that does not hold yet (a worker slot, capacity) keeps the contribution here; there is no separate capacity wait.

work.label: work in progress
work.description: Requested Work or a trusted operation is in progress.

human_wait.label: waits for a human
human_wait.description: A recorded `pending_human_action` names what a human must do; `/upstreaming resume` continues.

gate.label: waits for a human command
gate.description: Waits for a human command that starts the next step.

locked.label: locked, waiting for a fixed exit
locked.description: Write-fenced wait: only the listed exits leave it, and no Work, patch, or branch write happens while here.

generation_end.label: generation ended
generation_end.description: The current generation has ended; the record is kept for audit and late-effect reconciliation until a clean restart with `/upstreaming refresh`.

triggers.command: An authorized `/upstreaming` command. Commands that activate or approve work name the exact current revision; stop commands may name a stale one.
triggers.observation: A read-only observation by the collector: fork branch, CI runs, pull requests, review comments, or releases.
triggers.result: A verified native-queue Result folded by reconciliation. A Result is folded only when it matches the current generation, revision, and requested Work; any other Result takes `record_late_effect`. Each Result records its token usage in the events.
triggers.operation: A trusted remote operation receipt and its exact readback.
triggers.tick: A controller decision without new input: Work allocation, a budget charge or exhaustion, a deadline, or the stop after an unexpected error while one contribution was processed.
